name: Tsunagu Systems
description: Tsunagu Systems — a theme for an IT services company (managed IT for small offices), built around plan comparison: a formal white top header with the company name, a status line and the Book a consultation button, and under it a 200px wisteria side rail holding the numbered main menu. Wisteria (#BBBCDE) is the main colour: the side rail runs the full page height, the hero grid floor, the recommended plan column, the onboarding field, the consultation band and every page head are wisteria. The front page opens on a two-line headline over a centred tabletop model of an office network (a transparent cut-out photograph that overflows its grid floor) with five numbered callouts whose hairline leaders run to labels in a right-hand column; then a three-plan comparison table with a sticky header, the five parts explained row by row, four onboarding steps in one line, six questions in an accordion, one client case and a one-line consultation band where a cut-out laptop breaks over the band edge. Photographs are realistic high-key images (85mm, softbox light, near-white backgrounds, graded toward wisteria). IBM Plex Sans JP for headings and text, IBM Plex Mono for labels, numbers and prices. Sample content in English. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
